test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 61

questions.question: A cylindrical well with an inside diameter of 6 m and depth 30 m is to be dug; find the volume of earth excavated and the volume of brickwork for a 30 cm thick lining (in m³, rounded off to two decimal places; use π = 3.14).

A can complete a job in 15 days, B takes 20 days while C takes 30 days to complete the same job. All three begin working together. C leaves after 3 days, leaving A and B to continue working together. B leaves 2 days after that, leaving A to finish the job. The number of days (rounded to the next day) that A will take to finish the rest of the job is:

A, B and C started a business in partnership investing ₹1,00,000, ₹2,00,000 and ₹3,00,000, respectively. B withdrew ₹1,00,000 after 6 months, and C withdrew ₹2,00,000 after 9 months. In what ratio will their profits be divided at the end of the year?
A number is first decreased by 25%, then increased by 30% and finally decreased by 20%. What is the net percentage decrease in the number?
A general wanted to arrange his army of 2350 soldiers in the form of a perfect square formation, but was left with 46 extra soldiers. How many soldiers were there in each row?

A tank can be filled by two taps A and B in 12 hours and 16 hours, respectively. The completely filled tank can be emptied by a leakage point in 8 hours. If both the taps are turned on simultaneously and the leakage point is not repaired, how long will it take to fill the empty tank completely?

Find the interest (in ₹) on ₹8000 at 10% per annum for 2 years 6 months, where the interest is compounded annually for the first two years, and on the amount accrued at the end of two years, simple interest at the same rate is offered for the remaining six months.
Mean proportional between 40 and 250 is___________.
If the measures of the angles of a quadrilateral are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 4 : 5, then the measures of the angles are:
At what rate (in percentage) per annum on simple interest will a sum of money be 2 times of itself in 16 years?
27 identical solid spheres of unit radius are melted to form a single sphere. What is the ratio of the surface area of the bigger sphere thus formed to the total surface area of the small spheres?

The average age of girls in a class was 15 years. Three girls with average age 12 years got new admission in the class. Then the average age of the girls in the class reduced by 6 months. How many girls were there initially in the class?

A dishonest dealer claims to sell his goods at the cost price, but he uses a weight that actually measures 970 grams instead of the stamped 1 kilogram. Find his gain percentage, giving your answer correct to two decimal places.
A person spent 62.5% of the money he had on a tour, and was left with ₹18,750, how much money (in ₹) did he have for tour?
The average of the squares of the first 91 natural numbers is:
A scheme like ‘Buy 18, Get 2 Free’ on the same kind of articles with the same marked price attracts _____% discount.

Car M takes 7 hours to travel from point A to point B. It would have taken 8 hours, if the same car had travelled the same distance at a speed that was 15 km/hr less than its original speed. What is the distance between points A and B?
Two pipes, P and Q, can together fill a cistern in 4 hours. If pipe P alone can fill the cistern in 8 hours, then how long (in hours) would pipe Q alone take to fill the cistern?
Amit can make one wooden table in 2 days and Gopal can make the same table in 4 days. If they work together, in how many days will they make162 tables of the same kind?
The capacity of a cuboidal tank of water is 60,000 litres. Find the breadth of the tank, if its length and depth are 2.5 m and 10 m, respectively.
